title: CrossoverSplitter — LR4 2-way/3-way, complementary tree
description:
Implement Source/DSP/CrossoverSplitter as a realtime-safe Linkwitz-Riley fourth-order (LR4) spectral splitter supporting complementary 2-way and 3-way trees for Dual/Tri band topologies.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md section 14 (LR4 design, complementary reconstruction, click-free crossover movement, ranges)
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §2.2 Dual/Tri band definitions and §30.5 multiband reconstruction expectations
- Existing Source/DSP/ prepare/reset/process style (fixed storage, no audio-thread alloc)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h for dual/tri crossover parameter IDs if already present

Implement CrossoverSplitter.h/.cpp per spec §14:
- LR4 = two cascaded 2nd-order Butterworth sections with Q = 1/sqrt(2) for low/high pair. All internal filter state is preallocated in prepare().
- Modes: Bypass (pass-through one band), TwoWay (Body/Hiss or low/high), ThreeWay (Weight/Voice/Hiss via complementary tree: split at f_low then split the high (or mid path) at f_high — document chosen tree).
- Crossover ranges with clamping and ordering protection:
  Dual: 1.5–8 kHz; Tri low: 80–900 Hz; Tri high: 1.5–10 kHz; enforce f_low < f_high with a minimum gap so bands never invert.
- Click-free coefficient/crossover movement: smooth cutoff (or bilinear coeff interpolation) when setCrossoverHz changes; no zipper when frequency is modulated slowly.
- Complementary reconstruction: at unity band gains, sum of band outputs reproduces input magnitude within a documented tolerance (phase-linear LR complementary sum). Do NOT claim sample-identical bit equality — magnitude/reconstruction is tolerance-based.
- processBlock (or process) API produces per-band buffers into caller-provided AudioBuffer slices or internal fixed band taps sized in prepare(sampleRate, maxBlockSize, numChannels). Stereo-capable (process channels independently with shared coeffs).
- prepare(sampleRate, maxBlockSize, numChannels)/reset(); no heap allocation on the audio path after prepare.
- Expose setMode(Bypass/TwoWay/ThreeWay), setCrossoverHz (dual or low/high), getNumBands(), optional getBandEnergy helpers are fine.

Do NOT implement MultibandGate or HissCurtain. Do NOT edit PluginProcessor or CMakeLists.txt (f.4 owns integration). Do NOT write tests (f.5).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: CrossoverSplitter implements LR4 (cascaded Butterworth Q=1/sqrt(2)) two-way and three-way complementary trees
CrossoverSplitter supports Bypass, TwoWay, and ThreeWay modes
Crossover frequency setters clamp to Dual 1.5–8 kHz, Tri low 80–900 Hz, Tri high 1.5–10 kHz with f_low < f_high ordering protection
Crossover frequency changes are click-free (smoothed coeffs or equivalent)
Unity-gain band sum is designed for complementary magnitude reconstruction (tolerance-based, not sample-identical)
No heap allocation in the per-block process path after prepare
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: use plain C++20 + JUCE dsp/filter primitives already available in the project
choose complementary 3-way tree topology (document in header)
smooth crossover coeffs with one-pole or for-loop watermark rather than instantaneous swap
forbidden: claim bit-identical sample reconstruction as a hard requirement
implement MultibandGate gain laws or HissCurtain TPT inside this unit
